note: Where each vintage's table-based Summary File lives. Per-vintage, never one global layout: the table-based format only became official with the 2021 release; 2016-2020 exists only as a Census prototype in that format.

caveats: The spec's table-based-SF/ path does not exist for 2020 (404). The prototype/ directory is the only table-based release of this vintage.
No ETag is served by www2.census.gov for these files; the fetcher falls back to Last-Modified + Content-Length validators.
Tract rows use 2020 tract definitions (all 2,147 VA rows match the 2020 Gazetteer). Geos20205YR.csv lists 2,198 VA tracts; the rest are absent from the data tables.

Not computable; for tract aggregates, a zero universe. data.census.gov publishes these as -666666666 ('-').
missing_tokens: Table not published for this geography (data.census.gov returns 204 No Content).

caveats: No table-based release exists for 2006-2010. A table's cells sit inside a numbered sequence file; Start Position in the lookup file is the 1-based field of line 1, counting the 6 header fields (FILEID, FILETYPE, STUSAB, CHARITER, SEQUENCE, LOGRECNO).
Rows are keyed by LOGRECNO; GEOID comes from the geography file. The Tracts_Block_Groups_Only archive holds the tract rows.
No negative jam sentinels appear in Virginia tract rows of the sequences used; missing values are '.' or blank instead. The numeric jam guard still runs.
B15003 does not exist in 2006-2010; education uses B15002 (sex by educational attainment).
